newsitem.title: USA: SmithKline, United Healthcare in pact.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline, United Healthcare in pact.

text.p: SmithKline Beecham Clinical Laboratories and United HealthCare Corp said Monday they had agreed to a multi-year pact making SmithKline Beecham Clinical a preferred laboratory provider for United HealthCare.

SmithKline Beecham Clinical, a unit of SmithKline Beecham Plc, said it would provide clinical laboratory testing to help with diagnosis, monitoring and treatment of disease for the more than 10 million people served by United HealthCare health plans and preferred provider organizations.

"The agreement reflects SmithKline Beecham Clinical Laboratories's proven ability to provide quality laboratory services to national, multi-state managed care organizations at a local level," said Vijay Aggarwal, SmithKline Beecham Clinical vice president-managed care markets.
The companies were not immediately available for comment.
